Subject: MAP: Sprint catalog & cutover runbook — Stellarus Health

Jordan —

Thanks for the kickoff earlier. I pulled together a first-draft Mutual Action Plan that breaks the 90-day onboarding into focused sprints and a short cutover runbook. Attached: Stellarus_MAP_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet with milestone rows) and an early SOW draft.

High-level ask: please confirm the target go-live week of July 22 (we've sketched a soft cutover on Mon, Jul 22). If that works for your team we’ll lock milestones and owners so internal teams can schedule resources.

Quick summary of the proposed MAP (high level):
- Sprint 1 (Week of Jun 17): account setup, IAM, API keys, initial infra readiness — Owner: Karthik Iyer (Redwood)
- Sprint 2 (Jun 24–Jul 5): model selection, test harness, sample integration endpoints — Owner: Marissa Cole (Redwood) + Stellarus eng
- Data migration window (Jul 8–10): one-time bulk sync + validation — Owner: Ben Carter (Redwood) / Stellarus data ops
- QA & acceptance (Jul 15–19): end-to-end validation, perf tests — Owner: Neha Kapoor (Redwood) / Stellarus QA
- Cutover (Jul 22): production switch, post-cutover support runway (2 weeks) — Exec signoff: Marissa Cole / Jordan Ames

Open items for us to align on in this thread:
1) Procurement timeline — do you have a PO date we should plan around?
2) SOC2/compliance evidence — Priya, can you confirm which reports you need by the acceptance window?
3) Data migration details — scope and preferred windows (see attached migration checklist).

Next steps I propose: you confirm go-live week, Priya confirms compliance ask, and we update MAPv1 and re-issue. If you prefer a short call this week to finalize dates, say the word and I’ll lock 30 minutes.

Thanks —
Marissa

Thanks, Marissa —

Appreciate the clear breakdown. July 22 as a soft cutover looks achievable from our side pending one constraint: procurement. We are working to route a PO and I expect approval by Jul 10 at the latest. If that slips we may need to shift the acceptance window by a week.

Two quick clarifications:
- Data migration: our data ops team prefers a weekend window for the bulk sync to minimize impact. Can Redwood support Jul 13–14 as an alternate?
- Compliance: we need SOC 2 Type II evidence and a short runbook for audit logging (we will circulate specifics to Priya).

I’m looping in Priya (procurement & compliance) — Priya, can you confirm PO timing and what evidence you need for the acceptance signoff?

Jordan / team —

Thanks for the quick read. I pushed a short operational runbook into the MAP spreadsheet (sheet: Runbook) that calls out exact owners and blackout windows. Below is an extract of the operational milestones with ownership and proposed dates — please treat this as MAP v1.1 (we'll update after procurement confirmation):

Mutual Action Plan (extract):
- Milestone: Tenant provisioning & IAM setup
  - Target: Jun 18
  - Redwood owner: Karthik Iyer
  - Stellarus owner: Jordan Ames (eng lead)
- Milestone: Integration test harness up (staging)
  - Target: Jun 27
  - Redwood owner: Marissa Cole (oversight), Eng lead: Karthik Iyer
- Milestone: Data migration (bulk sync)
  - Preferred: Jul 8–10 (weekday window)
  - Alternate (Stellarus prefer): Jul 13–14 (weekend) — Redwood can support weekend but will need a small maintenance window (2–4 hours)
  - Redwood owner: Ben Carter
  - Stellarus owner: Stellarus data ops (Priya to confirm lead)
- Milestone: QA pass & perf validation (staging)
  - Target: Jul 16–18
  - Redwood owner: Neha Kapoor
- Milestone: Exec acceptance & cutover
  - Target: Jul 22 (prod flip)
  - Exec signoff: Marissa Cole / Jordan Ames

Notes on risks & mitigations:
- Procurement slip (risk): if PO not in by Jul 10, shift QA and cutover by one week; temporary sandbox can be used for earlier integration work.
- SOC2 evidence: Neha will provide a scoped evidence bundle (audit logs, retention policy) by Jul 5 to support procurement review.
- Data migration validation: we'll provide a lightweight validation script and checksums; Ben will own the run and coordinate a smoke test within 3 hours post-sync.

Attachments referenced: SOW_DRAFT_Stellarus_v0.3.pdf (please review clauses 3.2–3.4 for acceptance criteria). I also uploaded the runbook to the shared Drive (link in metadata).

If this looks good Jordan, please reply with an explicit +1 on MAP v1.1 and confirm whether your team prefers the Jul 8–10 bulk window or the Jul 13–14 weekend. Once we have that and a PO target date we'll circulate MAPv1.2 and a 30-minute alignment call invite for Thursday.

Thanks —
Karthik
